summary: Possible typosquat of @coral-xyz/anchor with unverified bundled code
details: Package name '@solana-labs/ancor' closely resembles the Solana ecosystem framework 'anchor' (published as @coral-xyz/anchor and historically @project-serum/anchor) and uses the @solana-labs scope. Pattern matches in lib/index.cjs.js and lib/index.esm.js show co-occurrence of require('child_process'), fetch/POST calls, and shell utility strings (curl, ping) within minified bundles, which is consistent with either an Anchor-like SDK build or a child_process+HTTP exfiltration shape. Full semantic tracing of the bundled code did not complete, so intent cannot be confirmed from the available evidence. Given the name-similarity to a widely used Solana developer framework and the unverified bundled behavior, route to human review for confirmation of publisher legitimacy and code intent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
